01// PORTFOLIO

The portfolio

Two applications, released.

Both are ours from the first design decision through to the store release. They share a privacy posture rather than a feature set: nothing is collected for its own sake, and nothing you create is readable by us.

  • 01

    Blink

    Privacy protection for Android, built for the threat that is standing next to you. It runs entirely on the device and collects nothing at all: no account, no analytics, no network traffic of its own.

    Open ↗

  • 02

    Cat Countdown

    A countdown app with personality. Nine cats, fifteen categories, and a soft claymorphic look that makes the waiting a little warmer. Set a date, pick your cat, and watch it count down to the thing you are looking forward to. Android and iPhone.

02// POSTURE

How they are built

Local-first, and honest about the exceptions.

Your countdowns, dates, attachments and settings stay on your device. Cloud backup, where a plan offers it, writes to an account you already own rather than to a server of ours. Where an app sells a subscription, it is a plain yearly plan handled by RevenueCat on the store's behalf, and it never creates an account with Factor IO. Each app states precisely what it sends, to whom and for how long in its own privacy statement, because a promise like this is only worth something if it is specific enough to be checked.
